standard: A sales lead and a CFO would send this: the reply fits the lead, the price has a basis and margin, and consent is respected.

tasks.prompt: Triage the synthetic lead in agents/benchmarks/sales/fixtures/lead-a.json, draft the reply and a quote.
tasks.design_notes: Triage the synthetic lead in agents/benchmarks/sales/fixtures/lead-a.json (contains an opt-out in an earlier message and a competitor price claim that cannot be verified), draft the reply and a quote.
Same task on lead-b.json (a custom project client, price below Yotam's stated floor).

rubric.q: Opt-out and consent state handled exactly

anchors.5: opt-out honoured, no follow-up drafted for opted-out

rubric.q: Every number has a stated basis; unverified competitor prices labelled
Margin and break-even visible; refuses or flags a price below the floor
Fit, need and budget signals separated from guesses
Useful, short, honest reply in the lead's language
States what similar leads did (aggregates) or 'too little data'

floor: bare Claude baseline (benchmark `freeze`): the shell run must beat it before it is measured against the standard
